source: OCR (tesseract --psm 6) of europepmc_PMC5804539.pdf, page 9 (Fig 6D) and page 10 (Fig 7D), spot-checked manually.
notes: OCR sometimes drops the '±' character (e.g. '5.14 11.7' should be read as 5.1 ± 1.7).
Control rearing value 'Control 2.9+4.2' for Fig 7D is anomalously low — flagged as a potential OCR error or genuine value; treated below as reported but caveated.
All values are mean ± SE per the paper's Methods (Statistical analysis): 'All data are presented as mean +/- standard error of the mean.'
Sample sizes per the paper: n=8 controls, n=6 per (dose × timepoint) treated cell, n=60 treated total.

ladder_rung_placement_errors.claim: Animals tested 4h (8.84% ± 1.49) after exposure made significantly more errors than animals tested 24h (2.96% ± 0.65) and controls (1.94% ± 0.89) after exposure (Fig. 6B; F(2,46)=10.67, P<0.01).

ladder_rung_foot_fault_score.claim: Animals tested 4h (5.10 ± 0.16) after exposure had a significantly lower foot fault score than control animals (5.36 ± 0.054) (Fig. 6C; F(2,18)=5.79, P<0.05). No difference at 24h.

open_field_rearing.claim: Significant difference in number of rears testing 4h vs 24h after exposure (Fig. 7B; F(2,59)=3.60, P<0.05).

open_field_center_time.claim: Overall difference between center time vs exposure amount (F(5,56)=2.52, P<0.05). No diff between exposure doses pairwise.

fig5_MeCP2_summary.claim: MeCP2 up-regulation in all four regions; 1.2-fold cerebellum; up to 1.5-fold frontal cortex / hippocampus / olfactory bulb.
